name: Hidaka Arisa
source:
Apparel company owner. She is an accomplished woman who branched out by starting a business with her friends when she was a student.

She is usually busy with her work and leaves her family to her husband, who is often away from home.

Since having a child, she has not been spending time with her husband at night, and she is not satisfied with her ripe body.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html]Official website[/url]]
